title: Magnetic graphene-based ferrite nanoparticles: synthesis, characterization, and anti-proliferative activity against some human cancer cells (in vitro study)
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,9054-9084
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00520A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Abdelsattar O. E. Abdelhalim, Nasra F. Abdel Fattah, Mohamed Z. Hussein, Mangoud M. Mangoud, Samah A. Loutfy
This work introduces a novel magnetic building block (GCM) of reduced graphene oxide conjugated with Congo red molecules and barium ferrite nanoparticles, enabling promising nanodevices as magnetically controlled nanorobots for cancer theranostics.
